summary: Iteration 2 testing completed successfully. Both new features (TTS audio narration and WhatsApp payment verification) are fully functional. Backend: 25/25 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All critical flows working including audio player and payment page.

react_native_issues.issue: expo-av is deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Should migrate to expo-audio and expo-video packages.

critical_code_review_comments: TTS audio endpoint working correctly with caching in MongoDB
OpenAI TTS using 'onyx' voice which supports Arabic but has American English accent - consider native Arabic TTS service for better pronunciation if needed
Payment flow correctly updated: self-confirm button removed, WhatsApp button added with correct number (201005394312)
Admin activation endpoint working correctly - admin can activate users via POST /api/admin/activate-user
Audio player UI well-designed with play/pause button, loading state, and clear Arabic instructions
Payment page shows different content for paid vs unpaid users (good UX)
All existing flows (login, course modules, lessons, quizzes, exams) still working correctly
